text: | Per-leg CI log | each ci.yml leg's merged stdout+stderr, written by `ci-leg.sh` to `target/ci-logs/{leg}.log` (matrix: `target/ci-logs/matrix-{platform}.log`), truncated at the leg's start; uploaded only on failure as artifact `ci-log-{job id}` (`if-no-files-found: ignore`), kept 7 days, from `target/ci-logs/` alone; unscrubbed build output (no user data — §8) | (.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:89-90; .github/workflows/ci.yml:48-54; .github/workflows/ci.yml:422-431) |

text: | Coverage report | the `coverage` leg's lcov file `target/coverage/lcov.info` — line counts of the workspace's public source, no user data (§8), `keyboard_compat.rs` excluded by filename since 2026-10-17-upstream-sync-engine-debts (test-plan §10 Coverage floors); uploaded only on success as artifact `coverage-report` from `target/coverage/`, kept 7 days — the one fork-CI artifact outside `target/ci-logs/` | (.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:40-47; .github/workflows/ci.yml:286-291) |

text: | Agent-run harness state | `target/agent-run/{status.json, events.jsonl, run.log}` — the test contract's status, its JSON-line events (§6) and the raw merged cargo/libtest output (unscrubbed, no user data — §8); local only, gitignored under `target/`, uploaded by no CI leg, removed by `agent-run.sh cleanup`, which touches nothing else under `target/` | (scripts/agent-run.sh:9; scripts/agent-run.sh:165-174; scripts/agent-run.sh:215-218) |

subject: ci
text: | Session state directory | the directory a session's caller names — in the checks `ss-life`, `ss-idle` and `ss-quiet` (blitz-tests) and `hb-*`, `hl-trace`, `hl-client`, `hl-client-rec`, `hl-cells`, `cc-*`, `cf-*` and `ht-timer` (seven_guis) under `target/tmp/` — created `0700` by the host, holding the socket file `session.sock` alone while a session is up and nothing after `stop` or after the host's idle expiry, which ends it exactly as `stop` does; no log, event or screen content is written into it; local only, uploaded by no CI leg; it belongs to the session library and its checks, not to `agent-run.sh` | (packages/escher-driver/src/host.rs:60-107; tests/blitz-tests/tests/session_common/mod.rs:333-341; examples/seven_guis/tests/common/mod.rs:17-25; examples/seven_guis/tests/host_log.rs:303) |

subject: ci
text: | Recording directory | the directory a session's launcher names by `--record` (or `Session::recording_into`) — created `0700` with its parent existing, refused `record-dir-not-private` when open to its group or others — holding one `check-{n}.json` (`0600`, `create_new`, never replaced) per recorded session, rewritten whole after every call through `.check-{n}.json.tmp` (`0600`) and a rename, removed by the recorder only when its recording ends on a failed write or a passed bound (400 records, 1,048,576 bytes) and otherwise never removed by escher; it holds call content at rest — target ids, a `press` key, an `advance`'s ms, unmasked typed text, a `type` to a masked or unresolved control as `masked` — with each call's `accepted`, its answer digest and the answer kept whole as `answer` — the line the driver wrote, masked as on every carrier, a shot's as `{width, height}` without `png` — so the screens' ids, names, values, snapshot text, diffs and a lint's findings at rest, and no log or event line; unix only; local only, uploaded by no CI leg; the checks write theirs under `target/tmp/`, and the cold-agent pipe's live `escher-session mcp --record` child its own under `target/cold-agent/record/` (the next two rows) | (packages/escher-driver/src/recording.rs:153-164; packages/escher-driver/src/recording.rs:259-271; packages/escher-driver/src/session.rs:166-190) |

subject: ci
text: | Cold-agent pipe state | `target/cold-agent/{verdict.json, events.jsonl, transcript.jsonl, client.log, server.log, check.json, record/}` — the run's verdict, its JSON-line events (§6), the client's raw transcript and stderr, the escher server's stderr (escher's sink, counted by span name) and the agent's check (raw by design, never printed — §8; `calls.jsonl` and `stub-state.json` retired at 2026-10-15-cold-agent-test); local only, gitignored under `target/`, uploaded by no CI leg (CI runs only the shim contract tests), removed by `cold-agent.sh cleanup`, which touches nothing else under `target/`; the per-run `mktemp -d` session directory, holding `mcp.json` alone, is removed when the run exits | (scripts/cold-agent.sh:17; scripts/cold-agent.sh:555-588; scripts/cold-agent.sh:593-596) |

subject: ci
text: | Cold-agent recording | `target/cold-agent/record/`: made `mkdir -m 700` by the pipe's live run, whose `escher-session mcp --record` child keeps one check per accepted `start` there (a recording directory, above); the replay children run without `--record`; the kept checks are never printed or copied and are removed by `cold-agent.sh cleanup` with the rest of the state; local only, uploaded by no CI leg, no kept check of the live run committed — the two committed Counter checks (below) the only committed ones | (scripts/cold-agent.sh:257-271; scripts/cold-agent.sh:570-577) |

subject: ci
text: | Committed checks | `tests/blitz-tests/checks/counter-cli.json` and `counter-mcp.json`, two kept checks in git (mode `100644`, a public repository) — the repository's own scripted stand-Counter sessions, written by `examples/seven_guis/tests/flows/record_checks.sh` (which prints only `step N`), holding the Counter's ids, names, values, snapshot text and diffs and the scripts' calls, no typed text, host path, name, secret or `screenshot` step — read by `stand_replay` and seven_guis' freshness check; no log or event line; uploaded by no CI leg | (tests/blitz-tests/checks/counter-cli.json:1-8; tests/blitz-tests/checks/counter-mcp.json:1-11; examples/seven_guis/tests/flows/record_checks.sh:1-65) |
